1	# The validation ladder
2	
3	Run bottom-up. Each rung catches what the one below cannot. All vsim
4	builds/tests run inside the vsim repo's container (built by its
5	`build_vsim.sh`); the andesim side runs on the host with `config.env`
6	providing `QEMU_BIN_DIR`/`VSIM_BIN_DIR`.
7	
8	## 1. Unit suite (seconds)
9	
10	```sh
11	podman run --rm -v <vsim-checkout>:/work -w /work localhost/vsim-env:latest \
12	  bash -c 'cmake --build build -j && ctest --test-dir build -LE hybrid-e2e'
13	```
14	
15	Catches: gate-map regressions (andes_caps tests), sweep encoding, X-macro
16	drift (`test_state_abi` pins the wire format size/offsets -- it changes
17	whenever a CSR list grows).
18	
19	## 2. Coverage guard (seconds, andesim repo)
20	
21	```sh
22	bash tests/andes_csr/test_csr_coverage_complete.sh
23	```
24	
25	Catches: inventory/matrix/ABI drift -- a CSR in the wire format without a
26	disposition, a disposition for a CSR the ABI dropped, or a hand-edited
27	matrix that the classifier policy does not reproduce.
28	
29	## 3. Cold-cache hybrid run = the caps validator (a minute)
30	
31	```sh
32	rm -rf ~/.cache/andesim   # force a fresh reset-baseline capture
33	./andesim run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:<engine> \
34	  --verify tests/fixtures/rt_c_hello.elf
35	```
36	
37	The capture is a FULL drain of the freshly reset hart and its CSR block
38	rides the batched PB sweep over the COMPLETE caps-supported list -- so a
39	clean capture empirically proves every claimed CSR is csrr-able on this
40	RTL. One over-claim aborts the run with the bisected name:
41	
42	```
43	[critical] fatal exception: csr_sweep: CSR 0x17 raised cmderr -- the caps
44	map over-claims a CSR the hart does not implement (fix andes_caps)
45	```
46	
47	Fix the named CSR's gate (see caps-gating.md), rebuild, rerun; repeat
48	until the capture is clean. Expect the `--verify` field count to DROP by
49	one per de-claimed CSR (e.g. premium went 146 -> 144 when 0x7D1 and 0x017
50	left the set) -- a drop is correct, those fields were zero-vs-zero
51	false matches before.
52	
53	## 4. --verify field diffs
54	
55	`[state-diff] FAIL` lines name mismatching fields. Triage order:
56	- Field never restored/re-read? Missing from an X-macro consumer (should
57	  be impossible if the lists are used) or caps-gated off on one side.
58	- Value differs only at reset (program never writes it)? Check
59	  QEMU-vs-engine reset divergence -> `andes_verify_excluded` in
60	  `driver/state_diff.cpp`, WITH a comment naming the divergence
61	  (precedents: msp_bound/msp_base all-ones-vs-zero, milmb/mdlmb enable
62	  bit, mip timer bit). Exclusion is for engine artifacts only -- never to
63	  hide a transport bug.
64	- Hardware counters that tick during the ROI (mhpmcounter*) are
65	  transported but verify-excluded by design, like mcycle.
66	
67	## 5. Full e2e matrix (minutes)
68	
69	```sh
70	QEMU_BIN_DIR=... VSIM_BIN_DIR=... VSIM_QEMU=... VSIM_QEMU32=... \
71	VSIM_PLUGIN=<andesim>/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so \
72	JOBS=8 bash scripts/run_e2e.sh
73	```
74	
75	Env vars must be on the command line (they do not persist between shells;
76	`source setup.sh` piped into anything loses its exports). JOBS=8 caps the
77	Verilator process count on big machines. Expect all tests green across
78	marker + pc + neg; the S/U fixtures (rt_priv_*) run on the S/U-capable
79	engine and take ~80 s each.
80	
81	## Cost model (why the sweep matters)
82	
83	Every Debug-Module operation (abstract command or PB exec) costs ~200-900
84	SIMULATED cycles at ~10 kHz wall speed, so full-drain wall-clock is

# The validation ladder

Run bottom-up. Each rung catches what the one below cannot. All vsim
builds/tests run inside the vsim repo's container (built by its
`build_vsim.sh`); the andesim side runs on the host with `config.env`
providing `QEMU_BIN_DIR`/`VSIM_BIN_DIR`.

## 1. Unit suite (seconds)

```sh
podman run --rm -v <vsim-checkout>:/work -w /work localhost/vsim-env:latest \
  bash -c 'cmake --build build -j && ctest --test-dir build -LE hybrid-e2e'
```

Catches: gate-map regressions (andes_caps tests), sweep encoding, X-macro
drift (`test_state_abi` pins the wire format size/offsets -- it changes
whenever a CSR list grows).

## 2. Coverage guard (seconds, andesim repo)

```sh
bash tests/andes_csr/test_csr_coverage_complete.sh
```

Catches: inventory/matrix/ABI drift -- a CSR in the wire format without a
disposition, a disposition for a CSR the ABI dropped, or a hand-edited
matrix that the classifier policy does not reproduce.

## 3. Cold-cache hybrid run = the caps validator (a minute)

```sh
rm -rf ~/.cache/andesim   # force a fresh reset-baseline capture
./andesim run --mode hybrid --trigger marker --engine vsim:<engine> \
  --verify tests/fixtures/rt_c_hello.elf
```

The capture is a FULL drain of the freshly reset hart and its CSR block
rides the batched PB sweep over the COMPLETE caps-supported list -- so a
clean capture empirically proves every claimed CSR is csrr-able on this
RTL. One over-claim aborts the run with the bisected name:

```
[critical] fatal exception: csr_sweep: CSR 0x17 raised cmderr -- the caps
map over-claims a CSR the hart does not implement (fix andes_caps)
```

Fix the named CSR's gate (see caps-gating.md), rebuild, rerun; repeat
until the capture is clean. Expect the `--verify` field count to DROP by
one per de-claimed CSR (e.g. premium went 146 -> 144 when 0x7D1 and 0x017
left the set) -- a drop is correct, those fields were zero-vs-zero
false matches before.

## 4. --verify field diffs

`[state-diff] FAIL` lines name mismatching fields. Triage order:
- Field never restored/re-read? Missing from an X-macro consumer (should
  be impossible if the lists are used) or caps-gated off on one side.
- Value differs only at reset (program never writes it)? Check
  QEMU-vs-engine reset divergence -> `andes_verify_excluded` in
  `driver/state_diff.cpp`, WITH a comment naming the divergence
  (precedents: msp_bound/msp_base all-ones-vs-zero, milmb/mdlmb enable
  bit, mip timer bit). Exclusion is for engine artifacts only -- never to
  hide a transport bug.
- Hardware counters that tick during the ROI (mhpmcounter*) are
  transported but verify-excluded by design, like mcycle.

## 5. Full e2e matrix (minutes)

```sh
QEMU_BIN_DIR=... VSIM_BIN_DIR=... VSIM_QEMU=... VSIM_QEMU32=... \
VSIM_PLUGIN=<andesim>/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so \

```

`source setup.sh` piped into anything loses its exports). JOBS=8 caps the

marker + pc + neg; the S/U fixtures (rt_priv_*) run on the S/U-capable
engine and take ~80 s each.

## Cost model (why the sweep matters)

Every Debug-Module operation (abstract command or PB exec) costs ~200-900

dominated by DM op COUNT, not bytes:

"""Completeness guard for the Andes-V5 CSR transport coverage (the flywheel).

Cross-checks three artifacts and fails on any drift, so "nothing missed" is a
machine-checked invariant, not a hope:

  1. csr_inventory.csv  -- the spec snapshot (every CSR in the SPA Chapter 5)
  2. csr_coverage.csv   -- each CSR's transport disposition (the matrix)
  3. include/hybrid/state_abi.h -- what the wire format ACTUALLY transports

Checks (any failure exits non-zero):
  A. completeness  : matrix covers exactly the inventory's CSR set
  B. policy parity : re-running scripts/classify_csr_coverage.py reproduces the
                     committed matrix (offline policy == matrix)
  C. abi vs matrix : every CSR the ABI transports has a transport-disposition in
                     the matrix (never an excluded one), and every "carried
                     today" CSR is actually present in the ABI

NEW/NEW_TRIG/NEW_UDELTA CSRs not yet in the ABI are reported as PENDING (the
ROADMAP backlog), not failures -- the guard tightens automatically as each
expansion feature lands and the CSR appears in the ABI.

Usage: check_coverage.py [--abi PATH] [--quiet]
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import classify_csr_coverage as policy  # noqa: E402

TRANSPORT = {"TRANSPORT_NOW", "NEW", "NEW_TRIG", "NEW_UDELTA"}

# Standard CSRs named as direct scalar fields in struct hybrid_state_v1.
STD_FIELDS = {
    "mstatus", "mepc", "mtvec", "mcause", "mtval", "mscratch", "medeleg",
    "mideleg", "mip", "mie", "mcycle", "minstret", "satp", "fcsr",
    "mcache_ctl", "mmisc_ctl",
}
# Array groups: matrix rows whose name starts with one of these are transported
# as a block (pmpcfg[]/pmpaddr[]/pmacfg[]/pmaaddr[] in the ABI).
ARRAY_PREFIX = ("pmpcfg", "pmpaddr", "pmacfg", "pmaaddr")
# V CSRs are transported but defined by the RVV spec, not this SPA -> not in the
# inventory; exclude them from the ABI<->matrix cross-check.
V_NAMES = {"vstart", "vtype", "vl", "vlenb", "vxsat", "vxrm", "vcsr", "vreg"}
# CSRs carried inside a composite ABI field, not as their own field. fcsr packs
# frm[7:5] | fflags[4:0], so both round-trip via the single fcsr field.
COMPOSITE = {"fflags": "fcsr", "frm": "fcsr"}


def norm(name: str) -> str:
    """Canonical CSR name across representations (case, fi/fl ligatures)."""
    n = name.strip().lower()
    return n.replace("ﬂ", "fl").replace("ﬁ", "fi")


# gdb/ABI name -> spec name, where the wire format uses a different mnemonic.
ABI_ALIAS = {"mcirq_entry": "mirq_entry"}


def matrix_keys(name: str) -> set:
    """All names a matrix row can be referenced by: each '/'-alternate, and each
    member of a 'prefixN~M' range (so the ABI's individual mhpmcounter3 matches
    the spec's mhpmcounter3~6 row)."""
    keys = set()
    for part in name.split("/"):
        part = part.strip()
        m = re.match(r"^(.*?)(\d+)~(\d+)$", part)
        if m:
            pre, a, b = m.group(1), int(m.group(2)), int(m.group(3))
            for i in range(a, b + 1):
                keys.add(norm(pre + str(i)))
        keys.add(norm(part))
    return keys


def abi_macro_csrs(abi_text: str) -> set:
    """Normalized names from every X(field, addr, "name") in a *_CSR_LIST macro."""
    out = set()
    for m in re.finditer(r'X\(\s*(\w+)\s*,\s*0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+\s*,\s*"[^"]*"\s*\)',
                         abi_text):
        out.add(norm(m.group(1)))
    return out


def load(path: Path) -> list:
    return list(csv.DictReader(path.open()))


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--abi", default=str(ROOT / "include/hybrid/state_abi.h"))
    ap.add_argument("--quiet", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    inv = load(HERE / "csr_inventory.csv")
    cov = load(HERE / "csr_coverage.csv")
    abi = Path(args.abi).read_text()
    errs: list = []

    # A. completeness: matrix covers exactly the spec inventory.
    inv_addrs = [r["addr"] for r in inv]
    if sorted(r["addr"] for r in cov) != sorted(inv_addrs):
        errs.append("A: coverage CSR set != inventory CSR set")
    inv_key = {(r["addr"], r["name"]) for r in inv}
    cov_key = {(r["addr"], r["name"]) for r in cov}
    if inv_key != cov_key:
        miss = inv_key - cov_key
        extra = cov_key - inv_key
        errs.append(f"A: inventory/coverage row mismatch missing={miss} extra={extra}")

    # B. policy parity: classify(inventory) reproduces the committed matrix.
    for ir, cr in zip(inv, cov):
        got = policy.classify(ir["addr"], ir["priv"], ir["name"], ir["mode"],
                              ir["section"])
        if got != cr["decision"]:
            errs.append(f"B: {ir['name']} classify={got} matrix={cr['decision']}")

    # C. abi vs matrix.
    abi_names = abi_macro_csrs(abi) | {norm(n) for n in STD_FIELDS}
    cov_by_name = {}
    for r in cov:
        for k in matrix_keys(r["name"]):
            cov_by_name[k] = r["decision"]
    # forward: nothing the ABI transports may be an excluded CSR
    for an in sorted(abi_names):
        if an in V_NAMES:
            continue
        dec = cov_by_name.get(ABI_ALIAS.get(an, an))
        if dec is None:
            errs.append(f"C: ABI transports '{an}' but it is not in the matrix")
        elif dec not in TRANSPORT:
            errs.append(f"C: ABI transports '{an}' but matrix says {dec} (excluded)")
    # reverse: every carried-today CSR must be present in the ABI
    abi_spec_names = {ABI_ALIAS.get(n, n) for n in abi_names}
    pending = []
    for r in cov:
        nn = norm(r["name"])
        pref = next((p for p in ARRAY_PREFIX if nn.startswith(p)), None)
        in_abi = bool(matrix_keys(r["name"]) & abi_spec_names) \
            or (pref is not None and f"{pref}[" in abi) \
            or (COMPOSITE.get(nn) in abi_names)
        if r["decision"] == "TRANSPORT_NOW":
            if nn in V_NAMES:
                continue
            if not in_abi:
                errs.append(f"C: carried-today CSR '{r['name']}' missing from ABI")
        elif r["decision"] in TRANSPORT and not in_abi:
            pending.append(r["name"])

    if errs:
        print("CSR COVERAGE GUARD: FAIL", file=sys.stderr)
        for e in errs:
            print("  - " + e, file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if not args.quiet:
        print(f"CSR coverage guard OK: {len(inv)} CSRs classified, "
              f"matrix==policy, ABI transports only matrix-approved CSRs")
        if pending:
            print(f"  PENDING (ROADMAP backlog, not yet in ABI): "
                  f"{len(pending)} -> {', '.join(pending)}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

// (_NDS_*, supplied by the build-generated cpu_config.hpp). This is the ONE
// place that binds each Andes feature gate to its config macro -- the sim-binary
// counterpart of the Verilator-free andes_caps.hpp, kept separate so the unit
// tests never need the generated header.

// cpu_config.hpp). A macro that is absent reads as "feature off" (gate clear),
// never a compile error -- so a core whose config omits a knob stays safe.

namespace hybrid {

{

#endif
#if defined(_NDS_POWERBRAKE_SUPPORT_INT) && _NDS_POWERBRAKE_SUPPORT_INT

#endif
#if defined(_NDS_STACKSAFE_SUPPORT_INT) && _NDS_STACKSAFE_SUPPORT_INT

#endif
#if defined(_NDS_PERFORMANCE_MONITOR_INT) && _NDS_PERFORMANCE_MONITOR_INT
  c.set(AndesGate::PERF_MONITOR);  // mcountinhibit, mhpm*, mcounterinten
#endif

#endif

  c.set(AndesGate::CLIC);          // mtvt, mintthresh, mcirq_entry

DM. So capability is decided from vsim's config.inc (andes_caps_from_config), not
from what QEMU drains. `mhpmcounter3-6` are HW counters that increment during the
ROI, so they are transported+restored but verify-EXCLUDED (like mcycle/mip).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Derive the andesim hybrid Andes-CSR capability list from a core's config.inc.

The OFFLINE checker for the hybrid handoff. It mirrors, in Python, the C++ gate
logic the vsim engine compiles in (src/hybrid/andes_caps.hpp +
andes_caps_config.hpp). At runtime the engine reports the same list via
`sim_<core> --describe` ("andes_csrs"), and the andesim driver uses it to skip
--verify on CSRs the engine lacks. Running this on the engine's own build
config.inc must produce the same list -- a drift guard between the offline
config and the built engine (the flywheel; see tests/andes_sim/
test_andes_caps_parity.sh).

Each Andes CSR is gated by a config.inc feature: a core implements the CSR only
when its feature is configured in. Restoring/draining a CSR the core lacks can
hang the DM handshake, so the engine and this checker gate on the same map.

Self-contained: the config.inc parser below is ported from Andes'
cpu_config_to_march_converter (parse_inc / is_yes / _int), so this depends only
on the Python stdlib.

Usage:
  config_inc_to_andes_caps.py <config.inc>                       # print the list
  config_inc_to_andes_caps.py --check <config.inc> <csr> [csr...]  # assert exact
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# --- config.inc parsing (ported from cpu_config_to_march_converter) ----------
_DEFINE_RE = re.compile(r'^\s*`define\s+(\w+)(?:\s+(.+?))?\s*(?://\s*(.*))?$')


def parse_inc(path) -> dict:
    """{macro: string-value} from a Verilog config.inc (`define KEY VALUE)."""
    out: dict = {}
    for line in Path(path).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines():
        m = _DEFINE_RE.match(line)
        if not m:
            continue
        name = m.group(1)
        raw = (m.group(2) or "").strip().rstrip(",")
        comment = (m.group(3) or "").strip()
        if not raw:                                   # bare `define NAME flag
            out.setdefault(name, "1")
            continue
        if raw.startswith('"') and raw.endswith('"'):  # quoted string
            out[name] = raw[1:-1]
            continue
        c = comment.strip().strip('"')                # numeric + // symbolic
        if c and " " not in c:
            out[name] = c
            try:
                int(raw, 0)
                out.setdefault(name + "_INT", raw)
            except ValueError:
                pass
            continue
        out[name] = raw                               # bare integer / token
    return out


def _str(cfg: dict, key: str) -> str:
    if key in cfg:
        return cfg[key].strip().strip('"')
    if key + "_INT" in cfg:
        return cfg[key + "_INT"].strip()
    return ""


def _int(cfg: dict, key: str):
    """Numeric view: prefer the _INT companion macro, else parse the value."""
    for k in (key + "_INT", key):
        if k in cfg:
            try:
                return int(cfg[k], 0)
            except ValueError:
                pass
    return None


def is_yes(cfg: dict, key: str) -> bool:
    s = _str(cfg, key).lower()
    if s in ("yes", "true", "on"):
        return True
    if s in ("no", "false", "off", ""):
        return False
    n = _int(cfg, key)
    return n is not None and n == 1


# --- Andes-CSR capability derivation -----------------------------------------
def _ecc_any(cfg: dict) -> bool:
    """mecc_code exists if ANY RAM block is configured with ECC (type != none)."""
    for blk in ("NDS_DCACHE_ECC_TYPE", "NDS_ICACHE_ECC_TYPE",
                "NDS_ILM_ECC_TYPE", "NDS_DLM_ECC_TYPE"):
        n = _int(cfg, blk)
        if n is not None and n > 0:
            return True
    return False


def _any_yes(cfg: dict, *keys: str) -> bool:
    return any(is_yes(cfg, k) for k in keys)


def gates(cfg: dict) -> dict:
    """Feature gates, mirroring andes_caps_from_config() in the vsim binary."""
    priv = _int(cfg, "NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS") or 1   # 1=M, 2=M+U, 3=M+S+U
    return {
        "DSP":          is_yes(cfg, "NDS_DSP_SUPPORT"),
        "CODENSE":      is_yes(cfg, "NDS_CODENSE_SUPPORT"),
        "POWERBRAKE":   is_yes(cfg, "NDS_POWERBRAKE_SUPPORT"),
        "STACKSAFE":    is_yes(cfg, "NDS_STACKSAFE_SUPPORT"),
        "PERF_MONITOR": is_yes(cfg, "NDS_PERFORMANCE_MONITOR"),
        "PMA":          (_int(cfg, "NDS_PMA_ENTRIES") or 0) > 0,
        "ILM":          (_int(cfg, "NDS_ILM_SIZE_KB") or 0) > 0,
        "DLM":          (_int(cfg, "NDS_DLM_SIZE_KB") or 0) > 0,
        "ECC":          _ecc_any(cfg),
        "ALWAYS":       True,
        # v4 M-ext gates.
        "UMODE":        priv >= 2,
        "SMODE":        priv >= 3,
        "TRIGGER":      (_int(cfg, "NDS_NUM_TRIGGER") or 0) > 0,
        "EPMP":         _any_yes(cfg, "NDS_SMEPMP", "NDS_EPMP"),
        "SMRNMI":       _any_yes(cfg, "NDS_SMRNMI", "NDS_RNMI"),
        "EXCSLVL":      (_int(cfg, "NDS_EXCSLVL") or 0) > 0,
        "CLIC":         _any_yes(cfg, "NDS_ECLIC", "NDS_CLIC"),
        "SMSTATEEN":    is_yes(cfg, "NDS_SMSTATEEN"),
        "CCTL":         _any_yes(cfg, "NDS_CCTLCSR", "NDS_CCTL"),
        "PPI":          (_int(cfg, "NDS_PPI_SIZE_KB") or 0) > 0,
        "FIO":          (_int(cfg, "NDS_FIO_SIZE_KB") or 0) > 0
                        or is_yes(cfg, "NDS_FIO"),
    }


# (csr name, gate) in HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST order, then the PMA group markers --
# mirrors andes_caps.hpp andes_gate_for() + supported_andes_csr_names().
_CSR_GATES = [
    ("mxstatus",       "ALWAYS"),
    ("mpft_ctl",       "POWERBRAKE"),
    ("mclk_ctl",       "ALWAYS"),
    ("milmb",          "ILM"),
    ("mdlmb",          "DLM"),
    ("mecc_code",      "ECC"),
    ("mhsp_ctl",       "STACKSAFE"),
    ("msp_bound",      "STACKSAFE"),
    ("msp_base",       "STACKSAFE"),
    ("mcountermask_m", "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("uitb",           "CODENSE"),
    ("jvt",            "CODENSE"),
    ("ucode",          "DSP"),
    ("pmacfg",         "PMA"),
    ("pmaaddr",        "PMA"),
    # v4 M-ext CSRs, in HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST order (gdb mnemonics, matching
    # supported_andes_csr_names which iterates that list after the Andes block).
    ("menvcfg",        "UMODE"),
    ("mseccfg",        "EPMP"),
    ("mcounteren",     "UMODE"),
    ("mcountinhibit",  "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mhpmcounter3",   "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mhpmcounter4",   "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mhpmcounter5",   "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mhpmcounter6",   "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mhpmevent3",     "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mhpmevent4",     "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mhpmevent5",     "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mhpmevent6",     "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mcounterwen",    "UMODE"),         # spec: PMNDS & misa[20] (needs U-mode)
    ("mcounterinten",  "PERF_MONITOR"),
    ("mcountermask_s", "SMODE"),
    ("mcountermask_u", "UMODE"),
    ("mnscratch",      "SMRNMI"),
    ("mnepc",          "SMRNMI"),
    ("mncause",        "SMRNMI"),
    ("mnstatus",       "SMRNMI"),
    ("mnvec",          "SMRNMI"),
    ("mrnxvec",        "SMRNMI"),
    ("mdcause",        "ALWAYS"),
    ("mslideleg",      "SMODE"),
    ("msavestatus",    "EXCSLVL"),
    ("msaveepc1",      "EXCSLVL"),
    ("msavecause1",    "EXCSLVL"),
    ("msaveepc2",      "EXCSLVL"),
    ("msavecause2",    "EXCSLVL"),
    ("msavedcause1",   "EXCSLVL"),
    ("msavedcause2",   "EXCSLVL"),
    ("mtvt",           "CLIC"),
    ("mintthresh",     "CLIC"),
    ("mcirq_entry",    "CLIC"),
    ("mstateen0",      "SMSTATEEN"),
    ("mstateen1",      "SMSTATEEN"),
    ("mstateen2",      "SMSTATEEN"),
    ("mstateen3",      "SMSTATEEN"),
    ("mcctlbeginaddr", "CCTL"),
    ("mcctldata",      "CCTL"),
    ("mppib",          "PPI"),
    ("mfiob",          "FIO"),
    ("tselect",        "TRIGGER"),
    ("tdata1",         "TRIGGER"),
    ("tdata2",         "TRIGGER"),
    ("tcontrol",       "TRIGGER"),
    ("mcontext",       "TRIGGER"),
    ("uzobctl",        "UMODE"),
    ("ucctlbeginaddr", "UMODE"),
    ("sleepvalue",     "UMODE"),
    ("umisc_ctl",      "UMODE"),
]


def supported_andes_csrs(cfg: dict) -> list:
    g = gates(cfg)
    return [name for name, gate in _CSR_GATES if g[gate]]


def main(argv: list) -> int:
    if argv and argv[0] == "--check":
        if len(argv) < 2:
            print(__doc__)
            return 2
        got = supported_andes_csrs(parse_inc(argv[1]))
        want = argv[2:]
        if got != want:
            print(f"MISMATCH\n  got:  {got}\n  want: {want}", file=sys.stderr)
            return 1
        print("OK: " + " ".join(got))
        return 0
    if len(argv) != 1:
        print(__doc__)
        return 2
    print(" ".join(supported_andes_csrs(parse_inc(argv[0]))))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

3	// A core implements an Andes custom CSR only when the matching feature is

27	// M-ext CSRs (HYBRID_M_EXT_CSR_LIST) -- standard + Andes M-mode CSRs whose
28	// existence depends on a privilege level or extension the core may not have.
29	enum class AndesGate : uint8_t {
30	  ALWAYS = 0,
31	  DSP,
32	  CODENSE,
33	  ZCMT,        // standard Zcmt table jump (jvt); NOT implied by CoDense
34	  POWERBRAKE,
35	  STACKSAFE,
36	  ECC,
37	  PMA,
38	  ILM,
39	  DLM,
40	  PERF_MONITOR,

42	  UMODE,       // needs U-mode  (NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS >= 2)
43	  SMODE,       // needs S-mode  (NDS_NUM_PRIVILEGE_LEVELS == 3)
44	  EPMP,        // ePMP / Smepmp (mseccfg)
45	  SMRNMI,      // resumable NMI (mnscratch/mnepc/mncause/mnstatus/mnvec/mrnxvec)
46	  EXCSLVL,     // exception save levels (msave*)
47	  CLIC,        // CLIC / enhanced CLIC (mtvt/mintthresh/mcirq_entry)

58	// Maintainer note: a CSR added to HYBRID_ANDES_CSR_LIST that needs gating must

98	    case 0x307: case 0x347: case 0x7EC:           // mtvt, mintthresh, mcirq_entry
99	      return AndesGate::CLIC;
100	    case 0x30C: case 0x30D: case 0x30E: case 0x30F:  // mstateen0..3
101	      return AndesGate::SMSTATEEN;
102	    case 0x7CB: case 0x7CD: return AndesGate::CCTL;  // mcctlbeginaddr, mcctldata
103	    case 0x7F0: return AndesGate::PPI;            // mppib
104	    case 0x7F1: return AndesGate::FIO;            // mfiob
105	    case 0x7A0: case 0x7A1: case 0x7A2: case 0x7A5: case 0x7A8:  // tselect, tdata1, tdata2, tcontrol, mcontext

109	      if (csr_addr == HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR || csr_addr == HYBRID_PMA_CFG0_CSR + 2)

112	          csr_addr < HYBRID_PMA_ADDR0_CSR + HYBRID_PMA_ADDR_NUM)

114	      return AndesGate::ALWAYS;                    // mxstatus 0x7C4, mclk_ctl 0x7DF

119	// compiled-in config (config.inc) in the sim binary and injected into the
120	// resume/drain loops, so they transport only the CSRs the core implements.
121	// Default = every gate on (all(): no gating, the prior unconditional behavior).
122	struct AndesCaps {
123	  uint32_t gate_mask = ~0u;
124	
125	  static constexpr AndesCaps all()  { return AndesCaps{~0u}; }
126	  static constexpr AndesCaps none() { return AndesCaps{0u}; }
127	
128	  constexpr void set(AndesGate g, bool on = true)
129	  {
130	    const uint32_t bit = 1u << static_cast<unsigned>(g);
131	    if (on) gate_mask |= bit;
132	    else    gate_mask &= ~bit;
133	  }
134	
135	  constexpr bool gate_on(AndesGate g) const
136	  {
137	    return (gate_mask >> static_cast<unsigned>(g)) & 1u;
138	  }
139	
140	  // ALWAYS-gated CSRs are present on every core regardless of the mask.
141	  constexpr bool supports_csr(uint16_t csr_addr) const
142	  {
143	    const AndesGate g = andes_gate_for(csr_addr);
144	    return g == AndesGate::ALWAYS || gate_on(g);
145	  }

  "type":     "verilator",
  "kind":     "cycle-accurate",
  "vlen":     512,
  "dlen":     512,
  "elen":     32,
  "xlen":     64,
  "triggers": ["csr", "pc"],
  "roles":    ["standalone", "accurate-leg"],
  "state":    ["resume", "drain"],
  "andes_csrs": ["mxstatus", "mclk_ctl", "milmb", "mdlmb", "uitb", "jvt"],
  "invoke": {
    "standalone":   ["{bin}", "{elf}"],

# CSR test artifacts required to ship a new vsim engine

Answer: an engine is shippable when six artifact groups exist and are green --
(1) the engine's `--describe andes_csrs` self-report, (2) the vsim caps unit
tests that model its config shape, (3) the andesim offline deriver + parity
flywheel entry for it, (4) the spec/matrix/ABI coverage guard, (5) its
`--verify` exclusion entries with named divergences, and (6) the empirical
validation ladder results (cold-cache PB CSR sweep, `--verify`, e2e).
"Nothing missed" is enforced by three machine checks (coverage guard, parity
flywheel, batched CSR sweep) plus one self-invalidating cache; a rebuild with
a different config is absorbed automatically by everything except the unit-test
config models, which must be updated by hand. Audit status as of 2026-07-02:
the parity flywheel currently FAILS and is not wired into `test_all.sh` --
details in "Gaps found" below.

Repos: andesim = `/home/nick/work/andesim`, vsim = `/home/nick/work/vsim_andesim`.
Engines present in the build: `sim_ax45mpv_premium` (shipping),
`sim_ax46mpv_advanced` (the new build; adds PowerBrake + StackSafe over premium).

---

## 1. The artifact checklist (what must exist, per engine)

### A. Engine self-report (vsim binary)

- `sim_<engine> --describe` must print the descriptor JSON with the
  `andes_csrs` array (contract: `andesim/docs/engine_interface.md`; parsed
  into `EngineDescriptor.andes_csrs` by `andesim/driver/engine_descriptor.hpp`).
  This list is computed at runtime by `hybrid::supported_andes_csr_names()`
  from `andes_caps_from_config()` (`vsim/src/hybrid/andes_caps.hpp` +
  `andes_caps_config.hpp`), i.e. from the engine's compiled-in `_NDS_*`
  macros. The andesim driver uses it to gate which Andes/M-ext CSRs
  `--verify` compares (`driver/state_diff.cpp`, `andes_supported_csr`), so a
  wrong list silently mis-scopes verification. Verified live: both engines
  emit it (`ax46mpv_advanced` reports 27 names).
- The engine's embedded build config,
  `vsim/build/V<engine>/obj_sc/config.inc`. This file, not the `external/`
  source tree, is the ONLY capability ground truth (observed divergence:
  built premium has perf-monitor + PMA on while its `external/` config.inc
  has them off). Every other artifact derives from it.

### B. Caps unit tests (vsim repo, run via ctest in the container)

- `vsim/tests/hybrid/andes_caps.test.cpp`: a helper that models THIS
  engine's config shape (pattern: `premium()` sets exactly the `AndesGate`s
  its config.inc turns on) plus `supports_csr()` verdict assertions,
  including the CSRs the engine must NOT claim (the hang/fault cases). Per
  the skill's TDD recipe, a new engine gets its own helper (e.g.
  `advanced()`); the helper is the machine-checked record of the engine
  shape.
- `vsim/tests/hybrid/andes_caps_config.test.cpp`: unit-tests the
  `_NDS_*` macro -> gate binding with controlled `#define`s. Needs a new
  case only if the engine introduces a config knob not yet bound in
  `andes_caps_config.hpp` (absent macro reads as "off", never a compile
  error -- but an unbound knob means the feature's CSRs stay gated off).
- `vsim/tests/hybrid/state_abi.test.cpp` (engine-independent): pins the
  wire-format size/offsets; re-run, must be untouched unless the CSR lists
  grew.

### C. Offline deriver + parity flywheel (andesim repo)

- `andesim/scripts/config_inc_to_andes_caps.py`: the Python mirror of the
  C++ gate logic. It must produce, from the engine's build config.inc, the
  byte-identical list the engine's `--describe` reports.
